title: Someone Put 8 Million Into SpaceX Calls and the Clock Is the Tell
speaker: tastylive host (Signal vs. Noise)

macro_themes.view: Tesla's strong deliveries are lifting SpaceX; SpaceX has less brand risk than Tesla and benefits from Elon's ties to the administration.

calls.reason: Two-day breakout from a multi-week range; $8.63M bought at the ask in Oct 30 172.5 calls plus Nov 20 225 calls through Nov 3 earnings; host holds a 170/175 call spread; prior June swing high ~172.40 is the resistance to watch.
calls.quote: Somebody paid real money for SpaceX to keep moving over the next 3 and 1/2 weeks.

notes: 'On this Monday' -> Mon Oct 5 (listing Oct 6). Ticker quoted as SPCX; normalized to SPACEX. Medium-term target 175 is the top of host's own 170/175 call spread; the Nov 225 call buyer targets the June high (~225.64) but that is flow, not the host's view. Analyst targets 115-800 listed but dismissed.
